item.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI), Nagpur, inaugurated the Saturation Campaign for re-KYC and Financial Inclusion (FI) Schemes at Deekshabhoomi, Nagpur, on October 21, 2026. The nationwide campaign, being undertaken in accordance with the directions of the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance, Government of India, and the RBI, will continue from October 21, 2026, to…
item.title: RBI Nagpur Launches Financial Inclusion Saturation Campaign at Deekshabhoomi
